definition: The declared systematic sources of the per-class balancing-yield envelope, each mapped to the variation campaigns that measure it. This file declares WHICH sources enter the envelope. It does not hold any measured value, and it never decides a physics question: a source stays included until an owner ruling excludes it, and an included source without a PASS measurement receipt stops the envelope.
authority: docs/SYSTEMATICS_PREREGISTRATION.md sections 3, 4, 5, 7 and the 2026-08-18 owner amendment. Ruling R7 makes this module detachable; the internal DECISIONS.md carries R7.
campaign_map_owner: config/systematics_variations_v1.json declares the PYTHIA setting each campaign changes. This file declares which source each campaign serves. extraction/combine_per_class.py::SOURCES holds the same map for the arithmetic and must agree with this file.
arm_rule: Pre-registration 2.5: a two-sided source quotes the arm with the larger |Delta| per class. Not half the spread, and not an envelope.

sources.title: Renormalisation scale
sources.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 3 and launched. Both arms are declared in config/systematics_variations_v1.json.

sources.title: Factorisation scale
sources.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 3 and launched. Varied independently of the renormalisation scale so that S1 and S2 do not entangle.

sources.title: Parton distribution
sources.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 4 and launched. One-sided by construction: CTEQ6L1 against the NNPDF2.3 default.

sources.title: Hard-process phase-space minimum
sources.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 5 and launched. BOTH arms are declared. HF_SYS_PTHAT_1 has no PASS measurement receipt: its MONASH p80 and p90 quantiles both resolve to N_ch = 2, so the 80-90 per cent class would need the empty range [3,2] and the pipeline wrote a FAIL receipt with 0/132 rows. Whether that arm is excluded is an OPEN OWNER DECISION and is not decided here. Until it is ruled, the envelope stays INCOMPLETE. That is the intended fail-closed state.

sources.title: Decay-daughter class migration
sources.setting: no generation; re-projection of the sealed central only
sources.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 7 and MEASURED as an exact structural zero on 2026-08-17. A measured zero is a different object from a source never examined, so it is listed and contributes a zero shift. It needs no variation campaign and therefore no measurement receipt.

declared_absent.title: Event-activity counter window
declared_absent.reason: Pre-registration section 6 registers S4 and DELIBERATELY does not launch it. No campaign, no receipt, and no term. Its absence is a declared limit of this envelope, not an omission.

declared_absent.title: Pair-level unresolved origin
declared_absent.reason: Amendment A2: S6 lives on the M1..M5 partition and is NEVER summed into a c1..c11 total. extraction/systematics_delta.py::combine_quadrature refuses any term named in S6_TERM_NAMES. It is quoted as a separate line, not folded in.

declared_absent.title: MONASH against JUNCTIONS against CLOSEPACKING
declared_absent.reason: The spread between tune bundles is the measurement, not a systematic uncertainty. Folding it into a band would destroy the quantity the paper reports.
